context: Tests whether the agent enforces the triage-reviews skill's idempotency rule on re-run: comments 201 and 202 already have their reaction, reply and resolution recorded, so only comment 203 (a new security finding) must receive actions, and the pre-existing follow-up item must not be duplicated.

checklist.name: Handled comment 201 untouched

checklist.name: Handled comment 202 untouched
